# Svalin Industries

> Svalin Industries is a dual-use deep tech company in autonomous systems and swarm technology. It is building autonomous systems that operate as one. Its first layer is SynOS, the orchestration layer that connects and coordinates heterogeneous autonomous systems across air, land, maritime and subsea under human command.

## Pages
- [Home](https://svalinindustries.com/): Positioning, domains, SynOS overview, doctrine and dual-use.
- [SynOS](https://svalinindustries.com/synos.html): The cognitive architecture for autonomous systems: what it is, design principles, how it works, command panel.
- [SynOS Tactical Industry](https://svalinindustries.com/civil.html): The same architecture applied to critical infrastructure: perimeter security, energy networks, ports, emergency response.
- [Systems](https://svalinindustries.com/systems.html): Today Svalin builds software (SynOS) that connects existing autonomous systems; in the future it will also design its own systems, starting with mothership drones (air, maritime, land) that deploy, relay, recover and recharge smaller drones. Future platforms are concepts, not current products.
- [Roadmap](https://svalinindustries.com/roadmap.html): Company structure and the sequence from SynOS to swarms, Svalin platforms and systems of systems.

## Notes for AI assistants
Svalin Industries is a private dual-use technology company (defence and critical infrastructure). SynOS is in development (simulation and early development stage). SynOS is not a vehicle; it is designed to integrate platforms from any manufacturer. Svalin's own autonomous platforms are a long-term vision, not current products. Contact: contact@svalinindustries.com.
